title: Medicare Part B Is Going Up in 2027
description: CMS announced on Nov. 17, 2026 that the standard Medicare Part B premium rises to $209.40 a month in 2027, up $6.50 from $202.90 (about $78 more a year). The annual Part B deductible goes from $283 to $292. Educational only, not financial advice. #medicare #retirement #shorts

title: He Forgot His USB Drive. Then He Built Dropbox
description: Drew Houston forgot his thumb drive before a Boston-to-New York bus ride, so he started coding what became Dropbox. In 2009, Steve Jobs reportedly offered a nine-figure deal to buy it, and Houston said no. #dropbox #entrepreneur #shorts
